subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal-mode continuation as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request adds core runtime behavior, protocol/API surface, UI/channel rendering, and goal-driver semantics, so the unresolved blocker is maintainer product and ownership intent rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Split staged PRs
options.body: Keep this hub open and ask for focused PRs for the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with proof for each affected surface.

options.title: Sponsor full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and resolve proof, compatibility, and ownership questions on the paired implementation branch.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintainers can reject or narrow the roadmap if these primitives should wait or move behind a smaller API design first.

recommendation.title: Split staged PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and ask for focused PRs for the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with proof for each affected surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the most relevant current-main history across update_plan, Codex user input, and session goals.
